page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 504.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes NVMe SSD local storage resources, configured as 8 local SSDs, to support high-throughput data access.

This server family is designed for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. With its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, it provides predictable compute performance. The inclusion of multiple NVMe SSDs makes it suitable for large-scale databases, real-time analytics, and memory-cached storage systems.
description: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-64-highlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine configured with 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 504.0 GB of RAM, yielding 7.88 GB of memory per core. Designed for high-performance data environments, this instance features NVMe SSD local storage with 8 local SSDs, ensuring low-latency data access. It does not include GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The combination of high memory density and fast local NVMe storage makes this server highly efficient for resource-intensive deployments. It is well-suited for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-cached applications, and data analytics.
